entries.title: Psalms 125:1
segments: ¶<<A Song of degrees.>> They that confide in Jehovah are as mount Zion, which cannot be moved; it abideth for ever.

entries.title: Psalms 125:2
segments: Jerusalem! --mountains are round about her, and Jehovah is round about his people, from henceforth and for evermore.

entries.title: Psalms 125:3
segments: For the sceptre of wickedness shall not rest upon the lot of the righteous; lest the righteous put forth their hands unto iniquity.

entries.title: Psalms 125:4
segments: ¶Do good, O Jehovah, unto the good, and to them that are upright in their hearts.

entries.title: Psalms 125:5
segments: But as for such as turn aside unto their crooked ways, Jehovah will lead them forth with the workers of iniquity. Peace be upon Israel!
